/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import csv, datetime, io
values=['2025-03-03','2024-07-12','2026-07-04','2023-09-21','2019-11-05','2024-02-29','2025-10-01','2025-06-08','2027-12-31','2022-05-14','1937-05-27','2026-01-02','2028-02-15','2025-11-01','2024-08-09','1990-04-23','2021-10-03','2023-06-30','2026-01-15','2025-12-01']
lines=Path('sentences.txt').read_text().splitlines()
assert len(values)==len(lines)
output=io.StringIO()
writer=csv.writer(output,lineterminator='\\n')
writer.writerow(['id','date'])
for line,date in zip(lines,values):
    datetime.date.fromisoformat(date)
    writer.writerow([line.split('\\t',1)[0],date])
Path('dates.csv').write_text(output.getvalue())
with Path('dates.csv').open() as f:
    rows=list(csv.reader(f))
assert rows[0]==['id','date'] and len(rows)==21
print(Path('dates.csv').read_text())
PY"
